@gpu.policy: D3D11_1/WebGL2/WebGPU/OpenCL/GLSL providers are declared, measured, then admitted by XCFE/KUHUL.

@glsl.policy: OpenGL 4.3 compute (GL_ARB_compute_shader + SSBO) is the universal GPU path — every GPU since 2012. json_runtime dispatches GLSL compute through the glsl_gpu sidecar (sco/sidecars/glsl.json). This is the admission point for the Hive's Shader Expert System (MoE shader routing: phase from shader signature, closest expert by pi-geodesic distance, top-1 dispatch).

dispatch_paths: gl_infer_driver.dll — OpenGL 4.3 compute inference (8 GLSL shaders: embed, layernorm, matmul, attention, gelu, add_bias, residual, lm_head)

xcfe_gl_ops.dll — GGML tensor bridge on the wgpu_native GL backend (17 WGSL kernels: mul_mat, get_rows, norm, rms_norm, gelu, gelu_quick, silu, relu, tanh, sigmoid, add, sub, mul, soft_max, rope, concat, cpy)
GLSL_Server.exe — PyInstaller HTTP server wrapping kuhul/glsl_server.py (port 9060; works from source, PyInstaller packaging has a missing-http-module issue)

gl_infer_driver.status: compiled (probe + stub dispatch; full compute dispatch compiles when GL/glew headers linked)

xcfe_gl_ops.seam: xcfe_gl_run(op, inputs, n_inputs, out, ne_out, n_dims, params, n_params)
xcfe_gl_ops.wgpu_backend: wgpu_native-release.dll (GL backend preferred, then D3D11, then D3D12)
xcfe_gl_ops.verified: MUL_MAT max err 4.768e-07 (2026-08-06); remaining 16 kernels need op-level harness

wgpu_native.role: WebGPU native library — the GL backend is how WGSL kernels run on the HD 4600

powernaut_pipeline.manifest: server.glsl.json (backend gl43_compute, ICD ig75icd64.dll, SSBO buffer pool small/medium/large, port 9060)
powernaut_pipeline.kernel: neural_layer.glsl (#version 430 core, local_size 16x16, SSBO bindings 0-3, dense forward + ReLU; mirrors neural_layer.wgsl)
powernaut_pipeline.server: dist/GLSL_Server.exe (PyInstaller; works from source via python kuhul/glsl_server.py)
powernaut_pipeline.system_aware: probes GPU ICD at startup (ig75icd64/atio6axx/nvoglv64), detects GL version, compiles shaders for target GPU

rendering.opengl_frame_adapter: dist/v3.5.0-WebX/native/runtime/opengl_frame_adapter.cpp — OpenGL frame → Atomic DOM (rendering/UI frames, not compute)

planned: tools/emit_glsl.py — KLSL GLSL emit target (adds to HLSL + WGSL)
scratch/gl/shaders/ — GLSL versions of the 7 inference shaders
